in_marathi.name: Ragupathi
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ragupathi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ragupathi is a name derived from the Sanskrit language, which means 'Lord Vishnu'. In Hinduism, Vishnu is one of the principal deities, known as the preserver of the universe. This name is often used as a term of reverence and is believed to bring blessings of loyalty, protection, and strength.
